summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares nivolumab and relatlimab given with chemotherapy against pembrolizumab given with chemotherapy as first-line treatment for stage IV or recurrent non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer with PD-L1 expression of 1% or more. The record says the drugs are given at specified doses on specified days, but the exact schedule and duration are not stated. The main outcome is not stated; the record says the study aims to compare efficacy between the two treatment groups.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara nivolumab y relatlimab administrados con quimioterapia contra pembrolizumab administrado con quimioterapia, como tratamiento de primera línea para cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas no escamoso en estadio IV o recurrente, con expresión de PD-L1 de 1% o más. El registro indica que los medicamentos se dan en dosis específicas en días específicos, pero el horario exacto y la duración no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica; el registro señala que el estudio busca comparar la eficacia entre los dos grupos de tratamiento.
who_for: Stage IV or recurrent non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer.
No prior systemic therapy for advanced or metastatic disease as primary treatment.
PD-L1 tumor cell score of 1% or more on central laboratory testing.
Measurable disease on CT or MRI per RECIST v1.1.
ECOG performance status of 1 or less and life expectancy of at least 3 months.
not_for: EGFR, ALK, or ROS1 mutations sensitive to available targeted inhibitors, or unknown status for these.
Known sensitive BRAF V600E, activating RET mutation, or NTRK fusion; unknown BRAF, RET, or NTRK status does not exclude.
Untreated brain metastases or leptomeningeal metastases.
Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-PD-L2, or anti-CTLA-4 therapy, with some adjuvant or neoadjuvant exceptions.
